name: Greenville Promenade

As a regional shopping destination for Greenville and surrounding towns, the center attracts visitors who prioritize practical shopping experiences with a mix of national retailers and local services.
description: Greenville Promenade stands as the premier shopping destination in Greenville, Texas, serving the retail needs of Hunt County and the surrounding Northeast Texas communities. Located at 6834 Wesley Street, this community shopping center has established itself as a convenient hub for residents seeking a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and essential services. With a strong 4.2-star rating from over 1,680 reviews, the Promenade has earned the trust and loyalty of local shoppers who appreciate its accessible location and practical tenant mix. The center operates seven days a week from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing extended hours that accommodate the busy schedules of working families and professionals throughout the region. As Greenville's primary retail center, the Promenade continues to serve as a vital commercial anchor, offering the community a reliable shopping experience that combines everyday convenience with quality service.
